message: You're right, Bill; in my dissertation tunnel vision, I'm often forgetting that the issues that are front-and-center to my research are not front-and-center for other folks -- and you're also right that I should have tempered my language somewhat about the focus on working-class students: there's certainly good stuff that *doesn't* execute that myopic move that I've just admitted to making myself; it's just that -- in talking about working-class issues -- it's so, so easy to slip into a certain kind of discourse that I find deeply frustrating. But thanks likewise for helping push my thinking on this, and helping me to rein it in, as well, when I start making big, sweeping claims.
